About the Role

We're seeking a talented Fullstack WordPress Developer with strong expertise in custom theme and plugin development. You'll work on WordPress projects, including theme and plugin development, and potentially some Joomla projects (with appropriate support, depending on your familiarity).

This is a contract role for full-time work over a 5 month contract.

However, you'll work as if you were a full-time employee, participating in team meetings, communicating via Slack, and coordinating with other people on our team.

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Build custom WordPress themes that closely match designs with meticulous attention to detail
  • Develop custom WordPress plugins with clean, well-structured code
  • Take ownership of WordPress projects from concept to completion
  • Refactor and update existing themes and templates
  • Address other occasional full-stack developer tasks as needed for non-WordPress systems and situations (e.g. newsletter development)
  • Provide limited support for clients who have issues or problems (secondary responsibility)

 

Work Hours & Meetings

You must be available to participate in meetings between 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Los Angeles time (UTC-8)

Your work hours will be negotiable. However, this is a full-time position, and the condition of this contract work is that you only work on our projects and on a full-time basis. Preference will be given to candidates that can closely align with our US timezone schedule.

You have:

  1. At least 4 years of experience building custom WordPress themes and plugins
  2. Strong front-end development skills with an eye for detail
  3. Deep understanding of code organization, patterns, and OOP
  4. Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
  5. The ability to work independently and complete objectives without explicit direction
  6. The ability to deliver polished work, self-review, and catch bugs before others do. This means that for any front-end development you do, it should be near pixel-perfect in alignment with the design you're working from.

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity

  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits

  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • TypeScript

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

  • Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings zu Umsatz, Marktanteilen und Kampagnenperformance und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du planst in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Logistikteam die Lagerbestände bei Amazon und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Produktverfügbarkeit.

  • Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für unsere Key Accounts bei Amazon und löst operative Probleme wie Produktsperrungen mit kreativen und effizienten Lösungsansätzen.

  • Du beobachtest Wettbewerber, Markttrends und Amazon-Richtlinienänderungen und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale für unseren Kanal ab.

  • Du behältst die Kundenzufriedenheit im Blick, analysierst Bewertungen, erkennst Trends frühzeitig und stimmst Dich bei Kundenanfragen eng mit unserem Kundenservice ab.

  • Du bist intern die erste Anlaufstelle für Amazon-spezifische Fragen und arbeitest dich schnell und eigenständig in buchhalterische sowie rechtliche Themen ein.

 Dein Profil

  • Du hast Dein Studium, z.B. im Bereich BWL, (Digitales) Marketing, Wirtschaftsinformatik, erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem analytisch geprägten Umfeld mit, beispielsweise mit Bezug zum Online-Marketing (idealerweise Amazon) oder als Product Owner.

  • Du bist gut darin kreative Lösungsansätze zu finden und zeichnest Dich durch Deine Hartnäckigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit aus.

  • Du bist kommunikativ, scheust Dich aber auch nicht davor, wenn nötig, mit Formularen zu arbeiten.

  • Du hast Freude daran, quantitative Analysen in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen zu übersetzen, diese mit dem Top-Management zu diskutieren und eigenverantwortlich umzusetzen.

  • Du beherrschst das MS-Office-Paket, insbesondere Excel, sicher und verfügst über Erfahrung mit Amazon-spezifischen Tools wie Seller Central, Amazon Ads, Helium 10, Jungle Scout oder Data Dive. Kenntnisse in Visualisierungstools wie Tableau oder Power BI sind ein Plus.

  • Du bringst verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) mit. Weitere Sprachen wie Französisch, Italienisch oder Spanisch sind ein Plus.

Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben!

About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Italy for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Italy is one of our expansion markets. It has a broad industrial base, from automotive suppliers to machinery and food production, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Italy from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Italy.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Italy from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Italy end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Spanish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English and Italian. German is a strong plus

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Who we are

At supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution.

Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization.

That’s why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled.

Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you’ll feel at home at supermodular.ai.

Your role

supermodular.ai operates through three core roles: AI Strategy, Deployment Strategy and Forward Deployed Engineering.

As a Deployment Strategist, you are responsible for translating AI strategy into a live enterprise engagement. You own delivery inside the account, including stakeholder management, prioritization, execution and the initiatives we commit to next.

You work directly with enterprise leaders, engineers and operators to understand how their systems and workflows function today, identify where AI can create meaningful operational impact and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed inside the organization.

Each account is led by a two-person leadership pair consisting of an AI Strategist and a Deployment Strategist. Together, you run the account end-to-end. You work directly with the customer and own the relationship end-to-end.

You also work closely with two Forward Deployed Engineers, forming a four-person delivery unit responsible for execution inside the account.

This role suits someone who moves comfortably through ambiguity, leads complex enterprise engagements and connects AI capabilities to operational reality.

What you own

  • Delivery of committed outcomes, with AI systems running reliably in production

  • Day-to-day stakeholder trust and executive alignment

  • Technical solution design across deployed AI systems

  • Execution quality alongside Forward Deployed Engineers

  • Deployment and adaptation of supermodular’s internal playbooks and platforms

  • Identifying and shaping expansion opportunities within the account

  • Translating organizational problems into prioritized, executable AI initiatives

What you bring

  • You have 8+ years in complex software environments as an engineer, product manager or engineering manager, working across the full product development lifecycle from discovery to production.

  • You think strategically. You connect AI capabilities to what the organization is trying to achieve and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed.

  • You are curious and AI-first. You follow how models, agents and tooling evolve, and you understand where they create practical enterprise value and what it takes to run them reliably: evaluation, observability, safety.

  • You are a pragmatic, lean thinker. You have the technical depth to guide solution design, look for the simplest solution that works and make clear trade-offs.

  • You take the shortest route to impact. You find another way when the usual path is slow, work with what is available, and get results in front of the client early.

  • You work autonomously. You take ownership of the account, use sound operational judgment and carry decisions through to results.

  • You focus on business impact. You start from the outcome the organization needs and measure your work by the operational change it creates.

  • You are a systems thinker. You see how models, workflows, tooling, data and people connect across an enterprise landscape.

  • You are an excellent project manager. You set priorities, plan the work, keep commitments visible and deliver what the account has agreed to.

  • You negotiate well. You align stakeholders with different interests, agree scope and commitments, and keep the engagement focused on the outcomes that matter.

  • You are a strong storyteller. You frame a problem so executives want to act on it, make the business case for each initiative, and grow the account by showing what the next step is worth.

  • You lead through the team. You give Forward Deployed Engineers clear direction and room to build, make decisions together with your AI Strategist, and step in wherever the account needs you.

  • You have a bias to action. You turn discussions into next steps, keep work moving every day and follow through until it runs in production.

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos Power is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to lead the technical deployment of KP-FHR balance of plant (BOP) auxiliary systems engineering, including service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems. Reporting to the Balance of Plant (Power Generation System and Turbine Island) Leader, you will develop technical design solutions to enable the rapid deployment and integration of KP-FHR Balance of Plant Structures, Systems and Components (SSCs). This role requires a senior individual contributor with extensive experience in thermal and balance of plant technologies to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of the plant's balance of plant auxiliary systems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the design and deployment of the balance of plant auxiliary systems, focusing on service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems including pumps, valves, and related auxiliary systems that meet Kairos Power’s FHR deployment objectives.
  • Manage and coordinate external partners, suppliers, regulators and vendors related to BOP auxiliary systems.
  • Support supplier technical oversight, including review of supplier deliverables, technical deviations, test plans, and component qualification evidence while performing independent verification calculations as necessary.
  • Develop and approve system documentation deliverables as required by the project.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate the balance of plant auxiliary systems with overall plant design and operations.
  • Lead or support formal design reviews, interface reviews, hazard reviews, and technical readiness reviews for balance of plant components and subsystems.
  • Apply engineering principles and engineering codes & standards, such as ASME and ANSI, to the design, analysis, and evaluation of systems.
  • Lead design trade studies, performance analyses and optimization of balance of plant auxiliary systems to meet commercial and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee the preparation of technical specifications, design documents, and system drawings for all balance of plant auxiliary systems components.
  • Perform feasibility studies and risk assessments related to commercial balance of plant auxiliary systems technologies and subsystems.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts and strategies.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of the balance of plant auxiliary systems during the plant's startup phase.
  • Stay abreast of industry advancements, best practices, and emerging balance of plant technologies.
  • Develop and maintain system requirements, interface control documents, design bases, and verification/validation plans for balance of plant components.
  • Perform work within established scope, budgetary and schedule requirements.
  • Resolve complex technical issues and system/interface conflicts affecting BOP auxiliary system design, procurement, installation, testing, or commissioning.
  • Evaluate proposed design changes and technical deviations for impact on system requirements, interfaces, design basis, safety, quality, and configuration control.
  • Establish and maintain technical acceptance criteria for BOP auxiliary system components and subsystems, including criteria used for procurement, testing, and verification.
  • Provide technical disposition and recommendations for nonconforming conditions, test results, or equipment performance issues within assigned BOP systems.
  • Ensure design decisions, analyses, and technical resolutions are documented and traceable to applicable requirements, design inputs, and verification evidence.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • M.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years experience in the design and operation of balance of plant systems, particularly in the nuclear or thermal power sectors

  • Demonstrated experience of physical hardware deployment in heat transfer and water treatment systems
  • Experience with requirements management, systems engineering, or design control processes for complex engineered systems.

  • Experience applying engineering codes and standards relevant to BOP auxiliary systems, including applicable ASME, ASTM, ICC, ISO, and MSS standards. Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Software Engineer III, you will drive key architectural and technical decisions, lead the design and execution of complex engineering initiatives, and elevate technical standards across the Framework team. You’ll partner closely with principal engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure systems that power core ExtraHop products. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.

Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes.Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB.

This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance.
  • Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support
  • Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work.
  • Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage.
  • Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to to define technical roadmaps, break down ambiguous problems, and balance technical debt with delivery.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
  • Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in STEM field, Computer Science, Engineering, or related degree requiring systematic/analytical thinking
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong expertise in C and C++
  • Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems.
  • Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools)
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems
  • Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems
  • Scripting experience (Python or similar)

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

Weights & Biases at CoreWeave

CoreWeave acquired Weights & Biases to create the most powerful end-to-end platform to develop, deploy, and iterate AI faster. CoreWeave operates a growing footprint of data centers covering every region of the US and across Europe, and was ranked as one of the TIME100 most influential companies of 2024. By bringing together CoreWeave’s industry-leading cloud infrastructure with the best-in-class tools AI practitioners know and love from Weights & Biases, we’re setting a new standard for how AI is built, trained, and scaled.

The integration of our teams and technologies is accelerating our shared mission: to empower developers with the tools and infrastructure they need to push the boundaries of what AI can do. From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform.

Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises.

As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team.

What You’ll Do:

Performance Engineering at Weights & Biases ensures our systems and products scale seamlessly as usage grows. We embed performance thinking into every stage of development—diagnosing issues, designing scalable patterns, and building tools that empower every engineering team to deliver fast, efficient, and reliable experiences. Our mission is to make performance a shared responsibility across the company through data, automation, and collaboration.

About the role:

As a Staff Engineer on the Performance Engineering team, you’ll take technical ownership of complex performance challenges across the W&B platform and infrastructure. You’ll design and lead experiments to improve system scalability and latency, develop standardized benchmarking and load testing frameworks, and drive initiatives to prevent regressions across product surfaces. You’ll collaborate closely with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic understanding of system behavior. Day to day, you’ll blend investigation, architecture, and enablement—helping teams measure, understand, and continuously improve performance.

  • 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2 years focused on performance optimization, systems scalability, or observability.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, with strong systems-level debugging and profiling skills.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, queuing, concurrency, resource contention, etc.) and their performance implications.
  • Experience designing and implementing load testing, benchmarking, or performance regression frameworks (e.g., Locust, Gatling, k6, custom solutions).
  • Familiarity with metrics and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.) and performance data analysis.
  • Experience integrating performance measurement into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to design experiments, analyze large datasets, and draw actionable conclusions.
  • Proven track record of driving cross-functional technical initiatives from design through adoption.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience in performance engineering or SRE at scale (e.g., supporting multi-region, high-throughput systems).
  • Familiarity with frontend performance monitoring and web vitals.
  • Experience building developer-facing tools or frameworks.
  • Background in data systems, observability, or ML infrastructure.
  • Experience contributing to open-source performance or benchmarking tools.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You love to turn messy, complex performance problems into clear, data-backed stories that lead to concrete action.
  • You’re curious about how systems behave under real-world load and enjoy building experiments that reveal what’s really happening under the hood.
  • You’re an expert in transforming deep technical insights into tools and processes that empower other engineers to build faster, more reliable systems.
  • You find satisfaction in long-term, cross-team collaboration — helping others succeed by embedding performance thinking into their workflows.
  • You get energy from bridging theory and practice: designing scalable architectures and writing the code that proves them out.
  • You care deeply about measurement, iteration, and continuous improvement — not just fixing bottlenecks, but preventing them from ever recurring.

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
